input.description: Csupor Craft Beer Sorfozde is a small independent craft brewery, taproom and outdoor terrace venue in Hatvan, Hungary, brewing since 2014. Hospitality site for a restaurant-like local venue: it presents the rotating beer selection, tells the brewery story, and drives visits to the taproom with opening hours, location, maps directions and a click-to-call phone number. A small JWT-protected admin panel lets staff maintain the beer list.

business.positioning: csupor-craft-beer is positioned as a professional hospitality presence.

personas.name: The Decision Maker
personas.description: Evaluates hospitality options and controls the reservation.

personas.name: The End User
personas.description: Uses the hospitality offering day to day.

pages.name: Kezdolap
pages.purpose: Show what Csupor is in seconds and drive a visit to the taproom.
pages.rationale: The strongest page: it must answer "what is this place" and "should I go" without a scroll commitment.

pages.name: Soreink
pages.purpose: Present the rotating beer selection with style, ABV and tasting notes.
pages.rationale: Second-highest visitor intent. Data-driven from the admin-managed beer store so it can change weekly.

pages.name: A Sorfozde
pages.purpose: Tell the brewery story, the craft process and the awards.
pages.rationale: Credibility page. Absorbs the gallery: the brewery photography is art-directed into the story instead of dumped into a grid.

pages.name: Latogatas
pages.purpose: Convert interest into a visit: hours, address, directions, phone, amenities.
pages.rationale: The single conversion page. Absorbs Contact and replaces Reservations: this venue takes walk-ins and phone calls, not bookings.

pages.name: Impresszum es adatkezeles
pages.purpose: Required legal disclosures and privacy information.
pages.rationale: Legal is a CEF non-negotiable. Combined into one footer-linked page to respect the 4-page main navigation limit.

pageSummaries.objective: Communicate the core value and route visitors to conversion.
Build trust through story, team, and credibility.
Show the space or work visually.

content.ctaStrategy: One primary CTA per page, all leading toward "reservation".
content.toneOfVoice: Warm, plain, and confident — human and specific.
headlineGuidance: Lead with the benefit, not the feature.
Be specific and concrete; avoid generic superlatives.
Keep the primary headline to one clear idea.
sectionObjectives: Each section advances the visitor toward the conversion.
Front-load the value; prove it with real evidence.
Remove any section that does not serve a stated goal.
internalLinkingRecommendations: Every page offers a next step toward conversion.

internalLinkingPlan: Link the home page to every top-priority page with descriptive anchors.
Link supporting content back to its pillar page.
Cross-link related services, features, or products.
Every page links to a conversion page.
seo.canonicalStrategy: Each page self-canonicalizes to its absolute URL; no cross-page canonicals.
seo.metaStrategy: Unique title (≤60 chars) and description (≤160 chars) per page, keyword-led.

performance.renderingStrategy: Server-first with client islands for interactive regions; stream slow data.
performance.imageStrategy: AVIF/WebP with explicit dimensions, responsive sizes, and a prioritized LCP image.
performance.cachingStrategy: Cache static shells at the edge; revalidate dynamic data with explicit TTLs.
lazyLoading: Load heavy widgets (maps, charts) on interaction or when in view.
codeSplitting: Keep third-party scripts off the critical path.

requirements: Semantic landmarks and one h1 per page with ordered headings.
All interactive elements keyboard operable with visible focus.
4.5:1 body contrast; meaning never by color alone.
Meaningful alt text; decorative images hidden from assistive tech.
featureRequirements: Forms: visible labels, tied inline errors, correct input types.
Maps: provide a text/address alternative to the interactive map.

requiredPages.name: Terms of Service
requiredPages.reason: Governs use of the site and services.

requiredPages.name: Cookie Policy
requiredPages.reason: Required where cookies or tracking are used.

requiredPages.name: Impresszum

gdprConsiderations: Lawful basis for each processing purpose.
Explicit, granular cookie/consent management before non-essential tracking.
Data subject rights (access, erasure, portability) documented.
Data processing agreements with third-party processors.

kpis: Conversion rate on the primary CTA
Bounce rate on key landing pages

recommendations.title: Build the critical path first
recommendations.detail: Ship Dashboard, Home, Reservations, Sign Up before secondary pages.

recommendations.title: Build accessible components from the first line
recommendations.detail: Meeting WCAG 2.2 AA up front is far cheaper than retrofitting it.

recommendations.title: Lead with the strongest value proposition
recommendations.detail: Foreground "memorable experience" on the home hero.

recommendations.title: Instrument analytics from day one
recommendations.detail: Track reservation to learn what works.

recommendations.title: Sequence high-complexity features
recommendations.detail: Integrate Admin, AI Features, Authentication incrementally.

risks.mitigation: Sequence high-complexity features across milestones; integrate incrementally.

risks.description: 6 legal pages require professional review before launch.
risks.mitigation: Generated legal text is a draft only. It MUST be reviewed by a qualified legal professional before publication; CEF does not provide legal advice.

removedPages.dashboard: The admin panel is the entire back office and has one job (maintain the beer list); a separate authenticated home would be an empty shell. Principle 5 (simplicity).
removedPages.reservations: The venue takes no bookings. A booking flow would be a false affordance — Article IV forbids interfaces that mislead.
removedPages.signup: Admin credentials come from environment variables for a single operator. Public registration would be a security hole with no user need.
removedPages.gallery: Brief rule 25 forbids dumping every photo into a grid. The photography is art-directed into home, sorfozde and latogatas instead.
removedPages.contact: Merged into latogatas. For a taproom, address + hours + click-to-call is the contact surface; a second page would split one intent.
removedPages.menu: Renamed to sorok (Hungarian route) and scoped to beer only — there is no food menu.

droppedFeatures.booking: No reservation system — see the reservations page removal.
droppedFeatures.contact-forms: A form adds friction and GDPR surface for a walk-in venue whose conversion is a phone call or directions.
droppedFeatures.analytics: Not requested. Omitting it avoids a cookie-consent banner entirely, which is better UX and less JavaScript (Principle 18).
droppedFeatures.ai-features: No AI surface in a 4-page brochure site for a brewery.
